title: The Sessions list sends its rows before its Measures

statements.says: A read of the Sessions list sends its head, then its rows once the gate reads have landed, then each Measure on its own as it lands, then its end.
The gate is the five reads that decide which runs exist and what they are called: the run list, the first event, the last event, the title and the first prompt, issued ahead of the rest.
A Skill filter puts the activation read in the gate, because it decides which rows exist.
A reader who arrives already sorted by a Measure puts that Measure's reads in the gate, so rows are never drawn in one order and then moved.
Behind the gate come the Measures: Tool calls from the tool result read, Cost from the turn read, Faults from the tool result and model error reads together, and Friction from the decision read.
Friction rides the answer though no column draws it, because its read is already paid for.
A Measure lands whole, as one line, never as one line per read.
The Measure reads go out together, and a test asserts which lines came rather than their order.
The column headings are inert until the answer is complete, and the heading over a Measure that fell short stays inert after.
Where a Measure falls short the rows stand, its cells read a dash, and the answer's Gap names the Measures it could not read.
Where a gate read falls short there are no rows to stand, so the table is empty with a Gap.
A cell whose Measure has not landed is blank and carries the Arriving state, so no new word and no new symbol reaches the screen.
Nothing retries by itself, and a Measure that fell short comes back when the reader changes the Filter.
The midnight rule stands, and nothing cuts a run at a day boundary.
The glossary gains Measure.
Narrowing on half an answer is refused, so a shortened Depth read narrows nothing, and its Gap says so.
The list asks nine span-wide queries, up to eleven, not the four first costed, and nine against a Loki that runs four at a time is the shape measured at 13 to 15 seconds on a month.
Every query had to land before a single row could be drawn, because Readings.Unreachable ORs all nine, so one store read that timed out emptied the whole table.
One slow read no longer empties the table, and the whole-table wait shrinks to the gate.

The Trace store answers and falls short apart from the Events store, so a Depth it could not read says nothing about which runs exist, and emptying the table on it spent the whole Events store answer on a second store's outage.
Reading the list day by day was rejected again, because a run that began before midnight would arrive twice and the table would sort itself again under the reader's hand.

A gate of three reads, leaving the name to arrive behind it, was rejected, because the name is how a reader finds the run they want and a name that changes under the cursor is worse than one more round.
One line per read was rejected, because Faults sums two reads and a reader would watch the number climb without knowing which it had reached.
A fixed order for the Measures was rejected, because the API would hold finished work back to buy an order a test could read top to bottom.
Sorting while the answer arrives was rejected, because a reader who sorted on a Measure that had not landed would watch the table settle twice.
It replaces the one-page answer of the record in which the Sessions list answers as one page, and rests on that record's midnight rule.
A correction takes the Trace store Depth read out of the gate: where it falls short the rows stand un-narrowed, and the Gap says the table was not narrowed by a Depth it could not read.
A correction says Figure is a word of its own, how a Measure is written for a reader, so Figure leaves Avoid under Measure and never joins the banned words.
The read of the whole span is replaced by the record in which the list reads newest activity first, fifty rows at a time, with no span and no column sort, and the midnight rule stands.
